title: Most prolific decade
statementMd:
Which decade of publication has the most books? Show decade start year and count (no tie).

Expected columns: `decade`, `books`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT published_year / 10 * 10 AS decade, COUNT(*) AS books FROM books GROUP BY decade ORDER BY books DESC, decade LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
